cohort: 148 high-risk pregnant women admitted to the HUAP maternity hospital in Niterói/RJ between July 1, 2011 and June 30, 2012.
finding: The majority of high-risk pregnant women were young, had a companion, resided in the metropolitan region II/RJ, and attended prenatal care appointments; the most common reasons for hospitalization were premature amniorrexis and arterial hypertension.
